newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico same-day Cetes rate up on tight liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Mexico same-day Cetes rate up on tight liquidity.

text.p: Mexico's same-day Cetes rates rose 55 basis points in early trade to 28.70 percent, in a market marked by a shortness of liquidity, dealers said.
Analysts said that the holiday-weakened market had not reacted to the sharp increase in inflation reported on Monday.
Banco de Mexico said inflation for the first two weeks of December was 2.34 percent, much higher than expected.
"The market will start to react next year. For the moment everyone has their portfolios closed," said one dealer.
Bank notes and acceptances, including pagares, were trading 70 basis points higher at 29.05 percent.
Maturing credits are seen at 8.207 billion pesos.
